title: Assignment split by a constraint scope
statement: Let $V$ be a finite variable set and let $c$ be a constraint of arity three on $V$. An assignment of Boolean values to $V$ is equivalent to a pair consisting of its values on the three variables in the ordered scope of $c$ and its values on all variables outside that scope.
